title: Latest Bike Frames Spect Mira & Seka ExAero at Ride in Style

takeaways.text: Staff describe the ExAero RDC road frame (distinct from the ExAero GR gravel bike) as focused on stiffness and heavier than the Spear; it comes with SEKA's new Gladius riser-style integrated bar.
It keeps a BSA threaded bottom bracket and SEKA's wind-eye seatstay openings; the weights spoken during the weigh-in are not clear enough to use.

disclosure: Filmed at Ride in Style, a Malaysian shop selling SEKA, with its staff; claims are the retailer's.
summary: A Malaysian shop's first look at the new SEKA ExAero RDC aero road frame alongside the SPECT Mira.
